title: AIMetaconomy
tagline: The AIMetaconomy Metaverse Simulates Two Gold-based Economies.
description: We want to.build a AIMetaconomy Metaverse that simulates twin gold-based economies, delving into a digital realm where two parallel worlds thrive. With intricate algorithms at play, this immersive experience unlocks unprecedented economic interactions and possibilities. Explore, trade, and thrive in this virtual tapestry of wealth, all anchored to the value of gold. The boundaries of reality blur as the Metaverse becomes a playground for economic innovation. Prepare for a new frontier where prosperity and imagination intertwine!
how_its_made: We are using MUD, also Unity 2022.2.17.f1 and ReactJS to build autonomous world which is connected to gold event management and triggers management system using blockchain built through ReactJS and MUD. We tried to connect MUD ReactJS with Unity AIMetaconomy tank game template that was provided. We added our own twist to it by adding 1:1 virtual replication of 2 specific country economies, i.e. France vs. Italy, we added gold reserves, central banks and the loser of the game was the country who would  have the least gold reserves as a result of AI simulation and algorithmic transactions.
